post_freeze_rule: Any change to the pre-registered metric hierarchy, treatment contrasts, task strata, practical-effect thresholds, task-level reduction, bootstrap procedure, or paired-effects implementation creates analysis revision 2.

supersedes.reason: The paired-effects implementation omitted pre-registered secondary/primary metrics including important_artifacts_missed_count. The implementation gap was discovered before any reportable formal run, so revision 2 completes the frozen plan without using outcome data.
